headline: Enough Phone offers 5.3-inch handset to revive small smartphones
summary: The Enough Phone is a new small-form-factor device with a 5.3-inch screen, aimed at reviving compact smartphones as flagship phones keep growing larger. Buyers can choose stock Android or an anti-distraction operating system. Ars Technica says it won't win on specs but will actually fit in your hand.
